node.title: N=256 square-mass-16 high-variance collision exclusion
node.statement: For profile (3,4,0) at N=256,s=5, the conjugate-square mean is 16, the maximum is 100, and the exact negacyclic autocorrelation variance V is even. If V=0 the norm is the pure power 2^256. If V>=136, an exact logarithmic majorant log x<=log16+(x-16)/16-(x-16)^2/2070 gives |Norm(alpha)|<2^250. Hence any unresolved collision in this profile has positive even V<=134.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-27: removes the zero- and high-variance portions of one first-band N=256 profile. The bounded low-variance residual, profile (4,2,0), later bands, and total ledger remain open.
